reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Strengthening Namibia’s Health, Financing and Community Systems, capacity, and resilience toward a sustained epidemic control of HIV/AIDS, TB, and Malaria

description.narrative: Namibia - Multicomponent - Ministry of Health and Social Services of Namibia - MOH. This program has the following goals: To reduce new HIV infections and AIDS related mortality by 75% by 2022 from 2015 levels, and move towards ending AIDS as a public health threat by 2030. To reduce the national burden of TB by achieving fewer than 50 TB patients per 100,000 population by 2035. To achieve zero indigenous malaria cases in Namibia by 2022. The objectives of this program are: To reduce new HIV infections by 75% by 2023. To ensure strategies are in place for pandemic preparedness, response and recovery.. To reduce HIV related deaths by 75% by 2023. To strengthen community – based and led systems.. To enroll and retain 100% of newly identified PLHIV on ART by 2023. To ensure sustained and resilient systems for health across the country.. To ensure 100% ART coverage among TB/HIV co-infected patients by 2023. To accelerate TB case detection and achieve universal drug susceptibility testing for TB by 2023. To manage all forms of TB, among all ages and including drug-resistant and drug-sensitive TB, and achieve a treatment success rate of 90% by 2025. To achieve zero indigenous malaria cases in Namibia by 2023
